description: A React component implementing a dual-mode authentication UI (login/signup) utilizing Supabase for email/password authentication, with animated UI elements and validation logic.

methods.name: validateEmail
methods.description: Performs basic email validation, ensuring it is non-empty and matches a simple regex pattern.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Validates password length, requiring at least 8 characters.

methods.name: formatAuthError
methods.description: Converts AuthError objects into user-friendly error messages.

methods.name: AuthTwoPanel
methods.description: Main React functional component providing a two-panel sign-in/sign-up UI with form handling and animated switching.
